title: DexVerse: A Modular Benchmark for Multi-Task, Multi-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Building general-purpose dexterous manipulation policies requires benchmarks that go beyond isolated tasks to systematically evaluate policies across diverse interaction modes, sensory conditions, and robot embodiments. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in task and data diversity, embodiment coverage, or controllable visual variation, hindering studies of cross-task and cross-embodiment generalization. We present DexVerse, a large-scale and modular benchmark for dexterous manipulation. DexVerse includes 100 tasks spanning a broad range of manipulation skills, including object grasping and relocation, articulated-object interaction, functional tool use, bimanual coordination, non-prehensile control, contact-rich behaviors, multi-goal execution, and long-horizon multi-stage task completion. It supports 3 robot arms and 6 dexterous hands, and is extensible to new tasks, assets, and embodiments. To evaluate visuomotor generalization, DexVerse provides configurable visual variations in textures, background, lighting, and camera viewpoints. We further provide a VR-based teleoperation interface and 3,180 demonstrations with synchronized proprioceptive, RGB, depth, point-cloud, and state observations. We benchmark representative methods, including Diffusion Policy, DP3, OpenVLA, and $π_{0.5}$, across 19 tasks. Results reveal substantial challenges in task generalization and visuomotor robustness, establishing DexVerse as a promising testbed for general-purpose dexterous manipulation. Project page: https://ycyao216.github.io/DexVerse.site

AI.title_translation: DexVerse：一个用于多任务、多实体灵巧操作的模块化基准
AI.tldr: DexVerse是一个大规模模块化基准，包含100个灵巧操作任务，支持多机器人和手部，提供可配置的视觉变化和3180个演示，旨在评估通用灵巧操作策略的泛化能力和视觉运动鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准在任务和数据多样性、实体覆盖或可控视觉变化方面存在局限性，阻碍了跨任务和跨实体泛化的研究。构建通用灵巧操作策略需要超越孤立任务的基准，以系统地评估跨多样交互模式、感知条件和机器人实体策略。
AI.method: 提出DexVerse，一个大规模模块化灵巧操作基准。它包括100个涵盖广泛操作技能的任务（如抓取、重定位、关节物体交互、工具使用、双臂协调、非抓取控制、接触丰富行为、多目标执行和长周期多阶段任务）。它支持3种机器人手臂和6种灵巧手，并可扩展到新任务、资产和实体。为评估视觉运动泛化，DexVerse提供可配置的纹理、背景、照明和摄像机视角的视觉变化。还提供基于VR的远程操作接口和3180个包含同步本体感受、RGB、深度、点云和状态观测的演示。
AI.result: 在19个任务上对代表性方法（包括Diffusion Policy, DP3, OpenVLA和$π_{0.5}$）进行了基准测试。结果揭示了任务泛化和视觉运动鲁棒性方面的巨大挑战。
AI.conclusion: DexVerse被确立为通用灵巧操作的一个有前景的试验台，揭示了任务泛化和视觉运动鲁棒性方面的巨大挑战。
AI.translation: 建立通用灵巧操作策略需要超越孤立任务的基准，以系统地评估跨多样交互模式、感知条件和机器人实体策略。然而，现有基准在任务和数据多样性、实体覆盖或可控视觉变化方面仍然有限，阻碍了跨任务和跨实体泛化的研究。我们提出了DexVerse，一个用于灵巧操作的大规模模块化基准。DexVerse包括100个任务，涵盖广泛的操作技能，包括物体抓取和重定位、关节物体交互、功能性工具使用、双臂协调、非抓取控制、接触丰富行为、多目标执行和长周期多阶段任务完成。它支持3种机器人手臂和6种灵巧手，并且可扩展到新任务、资产和实体。为了评估视觉运动泛化，DexVerse提供可配置的纹理、背景、照明和摄像机视角的视觉变化。我们还提供了一个基于VR的远程操作接口和3,180个带有同步本体感受、RGB、深度、点云和状态观测的演示。我们对代表性方法，包括Diffusion Policy、DP3、OpenVLA和$π_{0.5}$，在19个任务上进行了基准测试。结果揭示了任务泛化和视觉运动鲁棒性方面的巨大挑战，将DexVerse确立为通用灵巧操作的一个有前景的试验台。项目页面：https://ycyao216.github.io/DexVerse.site
AI.summary: DexVerse是一个大规模、模块化的灵巧操作基准，旨在解决现有基准在任务多样性、实体覆盖和视觉变化方面的不足。它包含100个多样化任务，支持多机器人和手部配置，提供可配置的视觉变化，并附带3180个演示数据。初步基准测试结果表明，当前方法在任务泛化和视觉运动鲁棒性方面仍面临重大挑战，凸显了DexVerse作为通用灵巧操作研究平台的价值。
AI.keywords: 灵巧操作, 基准, 多任务, 多实体, 视觉泛化
AI.comments: DexVerse的创新之处在于其前所未有的任务数量（100个），支持多机器人和多手部的“多实体”特性，以及可配置的视觉变化，这些都直接解决了现有基准的局限性。其提供的大量高质量演示数据和VR远程操作接口也极大地降低了研究门槛。该基准对于推动通用灵巧操作策略的发展具有重要意义，尤其是在评估跨任务和跨实体泛化能力以及视觉鲁棒性方面。

title: SLORR: Simple and Efficient In-Training Low-Rank Regularization
summary: Low-rank factorization is widely used to compress neural networks, but modern models are often not naturally amenable to aggressive factorization without significant accuracy loss. Existing training-time low-rank regularizers can improve compressibility, but they often require SVDs of large weight matrices, modify the model architecture (introducing additional trainable parameters), or rely on stateful cached quantities. To address these limitations, we introduce SLORR, a simple, stateless, and architecture-preserving framework for in-training low-rank regularization, instantiated with two main variants based on the Hoyer sparsity metric and the nuclear norm. SLORR directly regularizes the original weight matrices using GPU-friendly approximations for the forward and backward passes of the regularizers, for which we provide approximation guarantees. We first evaluate SLORR on ImageNet-1K across short-horizon continued training of ResNet-50, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16, and pretraining of ResNet-18, where SLORR induces compressibility while introducing less than 8% training overhead. We further evaluate SLORR-Hoyer in LLM pretraining at 135M and 560M scales: SLORR-trained compressed models preserve performance substantially better than unregularized models while adding less than 1% average training overhead.

AI.title_translation: SLORR：简单高效的训练中低秩正则化
AI.tldr: SLORR是一种简单、无状态、架构保持的训练中低秩正则化框架，它使用GPU友好的近似方法直接正则化原始权重矩阵，能够在引入低训练开销的同时显著提高模型的可压缩性，并在ImageNet和LLM预训练上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有的训练时低秩正则化方法通常需要对大型权重矩阵进行SVD、修改模型架构或依赖有状态的缓存量，这限制了它们的应用。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了SLORR。
AI.method: SLORR是一个简单、无状态、架构保持的训练中低秩正则化框架，它通过Hoyer稀疏度度量和核范数两种主要变体实现。SLORR直接使用GPU友好的近似方法对原始权重矩阵进行正则化，并提供了近似保证。
AI.result: SLORR在ResNet-50, ViT-B/16, ViT-L/16的ImageNet-1K短周期继续训练和ResNet-18的预训练中，在引入不到8%的训练开销下提高了可压缩性。在1.35亿和5.6亿规模的LLM预训练中，SLORR-Hoyer训练的压缩模型比未正则化模型更好地保持了性能，平均训练开销不到1%。
AI.conclusion: SLORR是一种有效且高效的训练中低秩正则化框架，它在保持低训练开销的同时显著提高了神经网络的可压缩性，并在多种模型和任务上展现出优越的性能保持能力。
AI.translation: 低秩分解被广泛用于压缩神经网络，但现代模型通常不适合在不显著损失精度的情况下进行激进的分解。现有的训练时低秩正则化器可以提高可压缩性，但它们通常需要对大型权重矩阵进行SVD、修改模型架构（引入额外的可训练参数）或依赖有状态的缓存量。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了SLORR，一个简单、无状态、架构保持的训练中低秩正则化框架，它通过基于Hoyer稀疏度度量和核范数的两种主要变体实例化。SLORR使用GPU友好的近似方法直接正则化原始权重矩阵，用于正则化器前向和后向传播，我们为此提供了近似保证。我们首先在ImageNet-1K上评估了SLORR，包括ResNet-50、ViT-B/16和ViT-L/16的短周期持续训练以及ResNet-18的预训练，SLORR在引入不到8%的训练开销下诱导了可压缩性。我们进一步在1.35亿和5.6亿规模的LLM预训练中评估了SLORR-Hoyer：经过SLORR训练的压缩模型比未正则化模型更好地保持了性能，同时平均训练开销不到1%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SLORR，一种新颖的、简单、无状态且不修改模型架构的训练中低秩正则化框架，旨在解决现有方法在神经网络压缩中面临的挑战。SLORR通过GPU友好的近似方法直接正则化原始权重矩阵，并提供近似保证。实验结果表明，SLORR在ImageNet-1K和LLM预训练任务上，能够在引入极低训练开销（低于8%甚至1%）的同时，显著提高模型的可压缩性并更好地保持性能。
AI.keywords: 低秩正则化, 神经网络压缩, SLORR, 训练效率, 模型可压缩性
AI.comments: SLORR的创新之处在于其简单性、无状态性和架构保持性，这解决了现有低秩正则化方法在实际应用中的主要痛点。通过GPU友好的近似和近似保证，SLORR在不牺牲效率的前提下实现了有效的正则化，对于大规模模型压缩具有重要意义。

title: MulTTiPop: A Multitrack Transcription Dataset for Pop Music
comments: 8 pages, 4 figures. Associated web preview available at https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop
summary: We present MulTTiPop, a dataset of pop music segments and their associated multitrack MIDI recordings for the evaluation of automatic music transcription models. MulTTiPop contains 572 segments of popular music totaling 3.5 hours of audio, and contains songs from diverse genres and decades from the 1930s to 2000s. To collect this dataset, we perform metadata-based matching on song segments from the Lakh MIDI and TheoryTab datasets, manually identify an anchor beat between the audio and MIDI, then use beat tracking on the audio and warp the MIDI to match its tempo and timing. We evaluate state-of-the-art automatic music transcription models on MulTTiPop and find substantial room for improvement, with the best model achieving 38% Onset F1. More details and sound examples of MulTTiPop are available at https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Associated web preview available at https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop

AI.title_translation: 多音轨流行音乐转录数据集：MulTTiPop
AI.tldr: MulTTiPop 是一个包含流行音乐片段及其多音轨 MIDI 录音的数据集，用于评估自动音乐转录模型。它包含 572 个片段，总计 3.5 小时，涵盖了从 1930 年代到 2000 年代的各种流派和年代的歌曲。通过对现有数据集进行匹配、手动识别锚定节拍、音频节拍跟踪以及 MIDI 速度和时序校准来收集。在 MulTTiPop 上评估最先进的自动音乐转录模型，结果表明仍有很大的改进空间，最佳模型的 Onset F1 仅为 38%。
AI.motivation: 创建 MulTTiPop 数据集是为了评估自动音乐转录模型，因为现有模型在该数据集上的表现表明存在很大的改进空间。
AI.method: 通过基于元数据匹配 Lakh MIDI 和 TheoryTab 数据集中的歌曲片段，手动识别音频和 MIDI 之间的锚定节拍，然后对音频进行节拍跟踪，并将 MIDI 调整到匹配其速度和时序来收集数据集。

AI.conclusion: MulTTiPop 数据集为评估自动音乐转录模型提供了一个新的资源，并且现有的最先进模型在该数据集上的表现表明，在提高转录准确性方面仍有显著的改进空间。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 MulTTiPop，一个包含流行音乐片段及其相关多音轨 MIDI 录音的数据集，用于评估自动音乐转录模型。MulTTiPop 包含 572 个流行音乐片段，总计 3.5 小时的音频，涵盖了从 1930 年代到 2000 年代的各种流派和年代的歌曲。为了收集这个数据集，我们在 Lakh MIDI 和 TheoryTab 数据集中的歌曲片段上执行基于元数据的匹配，手动识别音频和 MIDI 之间的锚定节拍，然后对音频进行节拍跟踪，并将 MIDI 调整到匹配其速度和时序。我们在 MulTTiPop 上评估了最先进的自动音乐转录模型，发现有很大的改进空间，最好的模型达到了 38% 的 Onset F1。更多关于 MulTTiPop 的细节和声音示例可在 https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop 获取。
AI.summary: MulTTiPop 是一个新创建的多音轨 MIDI 流行音乐转录数据集，包含 572 个音轨，总计 3.5 小时，涵盖了不同年代和流派的流行音乐。该数据集通过匹配现有 MIDI 和音频数据、手动对齐节拍以及进行音频节拍跟踪和 MIDI 速度调整来构建。通过在 MulTTiPop 上评估现有自动音乐转录模型，研究人员发现模型的表现仍有待提高，最佳模型的 Onset F1 仅为 38%，突显了该领域进一步研究的必要性。
AI.keywords: 自动音乐转录, 多音轨数据集, 流行音乐, MIDI, Onset F1
AI.comments: MulTTiPop 数据集在流行音乐转录领域具有重要意义，因为它提供了高质量的多音轨 MIDI 数据，能够更精确地评估自动音乐转录模型。该数据集的多样性和覆盖范围（跨越多个年代和流派）使其成为一个宝贵的资源。然而，38% 的 Onset F1 表明当前模型在处理真实世界流行音乐数据时仍面临巨大挑战，这为未来的研究提供了明确的方向。

title: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
summary: Scientific ideas rarely start from a blank page. They inherit mechanisms, repair known limitations, and recombine pieces of earlier work, much like biological genomes. Current benchmarks still say little about whether AI systems can follow this inheritance structure. We present IdeaGene-Bench (IG-Bench), a benchmark for scientific lineage reasoning and lineage-grounded idea generation. IG-Bench is organized around the IdeaGene framework: each paper or proposal is represented as a set of minimal, typed, evidence-grounded Idea Genome objects, and a GenomeDiff aligns these objects to record inheritance, mutation, loss, external import, and novel insertion under six operational evolutionary dynamics. The benchmark contains 1,961 golden lineage traces, 1,085 curated Idea Genome objects, and 920 pairwise GenomeDiff records across 10 scientific domains. It supports two evaluations. IG-Exam (42 task types, 1,029 instances) tests closed-form lineage reasoning across Idea Genome abstraction, inheritance tracing, evolutionary reasoning, and lineage verification. IG-Arena evaluates generation with a lineage-conditioned Population-Evolution Score(PES), asking whether a proposal can be inserted as a coherent descendant of a given lineage population: it should inherit the right Idea Genome objects, vary meaningfully from nearby work, and offer selection value for future research. Experiments on 14 LLM-based scientists expose a compositional bottleneck. The strongest system reaches only 27.3% exact accuracy on lineage reasoning, and structured lineage context reshuffles system rankings rather than helping every participant uniformly.

AI.title_translation: 思想具有基因组：科学谱系推理和谱系基础的创意生成基准测试
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为IdeaGene-Bench（IG-Bench）的新基准，用于评估人工智能系统在理解和生成科学思想的演变过程方面的能力。该基准通过将科学论文表示为“思想基因组”对象，并跟踪它们之间的继承、变异和创新关系来工作。实验结果表明，现有的大型语言模型在科学思想的谱系推理方面存在瓶颈，准确率不高。
AI.motivation: 当前的基准测试未能充分评估人工智能系统理解科学思想如何继承、演变和创新的能力，而这对于科学发展至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了IdeaGene-Bench（IG-Bench）基准，该基准围绕IdeaGene框架构建。该框架将科学论文表示为一系列最小化的、有类型的、基于证据的思想基因组对象。GenomeDiff用于记录对象之间的继承、变异、丢失、外部引入和新插入。基准包含1,961个谱系追踪、1,085个思想基因组对象和920个GenomeDiff记录，涵盖10个科学领域。评估包括IG-Exam（测试闭式谱系推理）和IG-Arena（评估基于谱系的创意生成）。
AI.result: 在对14个基于大型语言模型的系统进行的实验中，发现了一个“组合瓶颈”。在谱系推理方面，表现最好的系统准确率仅为27.3%。结构化的谱系上下文重排了系统排名，但并未对所有参与者都提供同等程度的帮助。
AI.conclusion: 现有的大型语言模型在理解和生成科学思想的演变过程方面能力有限，尤其是在谱系推理方面存在显著的组合瓶颈。未来的研究需要改进模型在理解和利用科学思想的继承和演变机制方面的能力。
AI.translation: 科学思想很少是凭空产生的。它们继承机制，修复已知局限性，并重组早期工作的片段，这在很大程度上类似于生物基因组。目前的基准测试仍然很少说明人工智能系统是否能够遵循这种继承结构。我们提出了IdeaGene-Bench（IG-Bench），一个用于科学谱系推理和谱系基础的创意生成的基准。IG-Bench围绕IdeaGene框架组织：每篇论文或提案都表示为一组最小化的、有类型的、基于证据的思想基因组对象，而GenomeDiff则对这些对象进行对齐，以记录在六种操作性进化动力学下的继承、变异、丢失、外部引入和新插入。该基准包含1,961个黄金谱系追踪、1,085个精选的思想基因组对象和920个跨越10个科学领域的成对GenomeDiff记录。它支持两项评估。IG-Exam（42种任务类型，1,029个实例）测试跨越思想基因组抽象、继承追踪、进化推理和谱系验证的闭式谱系推理。IG-Arena使用基于谱系的群体进化评分（PES）来评估生成能力，询问一个提案是否可以作为给定谱系群体的一个连贯的后代被插入：它应该继承正确的思想基因组对象，与附近的工作有意义地区分，并为未来的研究提供选择价值。对14个基于LLM的科学家的实验暴露了一个组合瓶颈。最强的系统在谱系推理上的精确准确率仅达到27.3%，而结构化的谱系上下文重排了系统排名，而不是均匀地帮助每个参与者。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了IdeaGene-Bench（IG-Bench），一个旨在评估人工智能系统在科学思想谱系推理和生成方面的能力的基准。该基准将科学思想表示为“思想基因组”，并使用GenomeDiff来追踪它们之间的演变关系。实验表明，现有的大型语言模型在处理复杂的科学思想继承和演变方面存在显著挑战，准确率不高，并且在谱系推理方面存在组合瓶颈。
AI.keywords: 科学思想演化, 谱系推理, 思想基因组, AI基准测试, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的框架来量化和评估AI在科学思想演变方面的能力，这对于理解和加速科学发现具有重要意义。然而，基准的有效性和通用性，以及模型在更广泛的科学领域和更复杂的推理任务上的表现仍需进一步探索。模型在谱系推理方面仅达到27.3%的准确率，表明在这一领域存在巨大的改进空间。

title: OpenCoF: Learning to Reason Through Video Generation
summary: Reasoning has become a core capability for large models, especially when reliable decisions require understanding logical consequences. Recent video generation models offer a reasoning path distinct from previous Chain-of-Thought (CoT): reasoning can unfold through temporally connected frames, known as Chain-of-Frame (CoF) reasoning. However, existing video generators are primarily trained on general video corpora, still lacking diverse supervision and dedicated designs for CoF reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce OpenCoF, a framework comprising the OpenCoF-17K dataset, a reasoning video dataset spanning 11 task families, and Wan-CoF, a fine-tuned video model for studying whether diverse temporal supervision improves CoF behavior. Across four video reasoning benchmarks, Wan-CoF achieves considerable gains over the Wan2.2-I2V-A14B baseline. Building on this, we empirically explore more advanced designs for CoF capabilities, i.e., equipping the model with visual and textual reasoning tokens. This mechanism respectively captures low-level visual cues and high-level semantic priors for spatial and temporal reasoning. Through performance comparisons and attention analysis, we examine how these tokens contribute across model depth, denoising steps, space, and time. Our results suggest that stronger video reasoning requires both broad temporal supervision and explicit mechanisms for organizing intermediate reasoning state. We open-source the dataset, model, and code to facilitate future research on reasoning-oriented video generation.

AI.title_translation: 开放协同框架：通过视频生成学习推理
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了OpenCoF框架，包括一个包含11个任务的17K视频数据集（OpenCoF-17K）和一个名为Wan-CoF的微调视频模型，旨在通过视频生成实现链式推理（Chain-of-Frame, CoF）。实验表明，Wan-CoF在视频推理基准测试中显著优于基线模型。此外，研究还探索了通过引入视觉和文本推理标记来增强模型CoF能力的设计，这些标记分别捕捉低级视觉线索和高级语义先验。结果表明，有效的视频推理需要广泛的时间监督和组织中间推理状态的显式机制。研究开源了数据集、模型和代码。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频生成模型主要在通用视频语料库上进行训练，缺乏多样化的监督和专门为链式帧（Chain-of-Frame, CoF）推理设计的机制，而CoF推理是通过时间上连接的帧来展开的一种与以往的思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）不同的推理方式。
AI.method: 提出了OpenCoF框架，包括OpenCoF-17K数据集（包含11个任务家族的推理视频）和Wan-CoF微调视频模型。探索了通过引入视觉和文本推理标记来增强CoF能力的设计，这些标记分别捕捉低级视觉线索和高级语义先验，用于空间和时间推理。
AI.result: Wan-CoF模型在四个视频推理基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升，优于Wan2.2-I2V-A14B基线模型。通过性能比较和注意力分析，研究发现视觉和文本推理标记能够有效地捕捉不同层次的推理线索，并且模型深度、去噪步数、空间和时间维度都对推理能力有影响。
AI.conclusion: 更强的视频推理能力需要广泛的时间监督以及用于组织中间推理状态的显式机制。研究开源了数据集、模型和代码，以促进面向推理的视频生成研究。
AI.translation: 推理已成为大型模型的核心能力，尤其是在可靠决策需要理解逻辑后果时。最近的视频生成模型提供了一条与以往的思维链（CoT）不同的推理路径：推理可以通过时间上连接的帧展开，这被称为帧链（CoF）推理。然而，现有的视频生成器主要在通用视频语料库上进行训练，仍然缺乏多样化的监督和专门为CoF推理设计的机制。为了解决这个差距，我们引入了OpenCoF，一个包含OpenCoF-17K数据集（一个跨越11个任务家族的推理视频数据集）和Wan-CoF（一个用于研究多样化时间监督是否能改善CoF行为的微调视频模型）的框架。在四个视频推理基准测试中，Wan-CoF相对于Wan2.2-I2V-A14B基线模型取得了显著的提升。在此基础上，我们实证地探索了更先进的CoF能力设计，即为模型配备视觉和文本推理标记。该机制分别捕捉用于空间和时间推理的低级视觉线索和高级语义先验。通过性能比较和注意力分析，我们研究了这些标记如何在模型深度、去噪步数、空间和时间上做出贡献。我们的结果表明，更强的视频推理需要广泛的时间监督和用于组织中间推理状态的显式机制。我们开源了数据集、模型和代码，以促进面向推理的视频生成研究。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了OpenCoF框架，旨在改进视频生成中的链式推理（CoF）能力。该框架包含一个大规模的推理视频数据集OpenCoF-17K和名为Wan-CoF的微调视频模型。实验证明，该模型在多个视频推理任务上表现优于现有基线。研究还探索了通过引入视觉和文本推理标记来增强模型推理能力，这些标记有助于模型同时处理低级视觉信息和高级语义信息。最终，研究得出结论，有效的视频推理依赖于丰富的时间监督和明确的推理状态组织机制，并承诺开源相关资源以推动该领域发展。
AI.keywords: 视频生成, 链式推理, 帧链推理, 推理标记, 大型模型, 视频理解, 时间监督, 语义先验, 视觉推理, 文本推理, OpenCoF, Wan-CoF, OpenCoF-17K, Chain-of-Frame, Chain-of-Thought
AI.comments: 这项研究在视频生成领域引入了新颖的“帧链”（CoF）推理概念，并提供了相应的框架（OpenCoF）和数据集（OpenCoF-17K），为解决视频理解和推理问题提供了重要资源。通过引入视觉和文本推理标记，该研究为模型提供了更强的推理能力，并对这些标记的作用进行了深入分析，为未来的研究提供了有价值的见解。然而，对于如何更有效地融合这些标记以及其在更广泛任务中的泛化能力仍有待进一步探索。

title: Enhancing In-context Panoramic Generation via Geometric-aware Pretraining
summary: In this work, we present Canvas360, a two-stage framework for in-context panoramic generation that combines geometry-aware pretraining with downstream task-specific fine-tuning. To address the lack of large-scale, high-quality training data tailored to in-context panoramic tasks, we propose Canvas360Dataset, a collection of 1M high-quality paired panoramic samples for style transfer, inpainting, outpainting, and editing, enabling effective supervision across diverse in-context generation scenarios. On the modeling side, Canvas360 enhances text-to-panorama generation through parallel depth generation, velocity circular padding, and similarity loss regularization, enabling the model to learn geometry-aware representations, capture object distortion details, and improve geometric consistency and global coherence. Furthermore, empowered by strong panoramic priors, Canvas360 enables a unified in-context panoramic generation framework that supports diverse downstream tasks via token-level concatenation, surpassing prior methods in both task coverage and modeling flexibility. Extensive experiments show that Canvas360 improves panoramic image fidelity, achieving particularly strong performance on the panorama-specific FAED metric and competitive or leading results across the reported quantitative evaluations. More information can be found on our project page: https://zry000.github.io/Canvas360/

AI.title_translation: 通过几何感知预训练增强上下文全景生成
AI.tldr: Canvas360是一个两阶段框架，通过几何感知预训练和下游任务微调来增强上下文全景生成。它提出了一个包含1M个全景样本的数据集，并结合了并行深度生成、速度环形填充和相似性损失正则化等技术，以提高几何感知表示、细节捕捉和全局一致性。该框架支持多种下游任务，并在各种评估中取得了领先的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的上下文全景生成方法缺乏大规模、高质量的训练数据，并且在几何感知表示、细节捕捉和全局一致性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出Canvas360，一个结合几何感知预训练和下游任务微调的两阶段框架。构建Canvas360Dataset，包含1M个全景样本。在模型方面，通过并行深度生成、速度环形填充和相似性损失正则化来增强文本到全景的生成，以学习几何感知表示、捕捉对象失真细节并提高几何一致性和全局连贯性。
AI.result: Canvas360提高了全景图像的保真度，在特定于全景的FAED指标上表现尤为出色，并在报告的定量评估中取得了有竞争力的或领先的结果。
AI.conclusion: Canvas360通过几何感知预训练和创新的模型组件，成功地增强了上下文全景生成能力，并为多种下游任务提供了一个统一且灵活的框架，在各项评估中均展现出优越性能。
AI.translation: 本研究提出了Canvas360，一个用于上下文全景生成的两阶段框架，结合了几何感知预训练和下游任务的特定微调。为了解决缺乏针对上下文全景任务量身定制的大规模、高质量训练数据的问题，我们提出了Canvas360Dataset，一个包含1M个高质量配对全景样本的集合，用于风格迁移、修复、外绘和编辑，从而在各种上下文生成场景中实现有效的监督。在模型方面，Canvas360通过并行深度生成、速度环形填充和相似性损失正则化来增强文本到全景的生成，使模型能够学习几何感知表示、捕捉对象失真细节，并提高几何一致性和全局连贯性。此外，凭借强大的全景先验知识，Canvas360实现了一个统一的上下文全景生成框架，通过令牌级连接支持各种下游任务，在任务覆盖范围和模型灵活性方面均超越了先前的方法。大量的实验表明，Canvas360提高了全景图像的保真度，在特定于全景的FAED指标上取得了尤其强劲的性能，并在所报告的定量评估中取得了有竞争力的或领先的结果。更多信息可在我们的项目页面找到：https://zry000.github.io/Canvas360/
AI.summary: Canvas360是一个创新的两阶段框架，旨在通过几何感知预训练来增强上下文全景生成。它引入了一个包含100万个高质量全景样本的大型数据集，并采用了一系列先进的模型技术，如并行深度生成、速度环形填充和相似性损失正则化，以提高几何感知能力、细节准确性和全局一致性。该框架能够支持多种下游任务，并且在广泛的实验评估中表现出色，尤其是在FAED指标上。
AI.keywords: 上下文全景生成, 几何感知预训练, Canvas360, 图像生成, 全景数据集
AI.comments: 该研究提出的Canvas360框架在上下文全景生成领域取得了显著进展。通过引入大规模数据集和几何感知预训练，有效解决了现有方法的局限性。该框架在处理多种下游任务时展现出的灵活性和优越性能，预示着其在全景内容创作和编辑领域的广阔应用前景。然而，对于计算资源的消耗和在不同设备上的部署效率仍有待进一步的评估。

title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
summary: We propose OPSD-V, an on-policy self-distillation paradigm for post-training few-step autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models. Existing few-step AR video generators can produce long videos with low latency, but still suffer from error accumulation and weakened motion dynamics during long autoregressive rollout. OPSD-V reduces long-horizon degradation while preserving the original few-step inference path. The key idea is to introduce real long-video data as temporal context during training and use it to provide dense trajectory-level supervision. Specifically, the student follows the exact inference-time rollout, generating each chunk conditioned on its own previously generated KV cache. In parallel, the teacher is evaluated at the same student-visited denoising states, but uses a cleaner AR-consistent temporal cache in which older history can be replaced by real-video context. This provides dense denoising-level corrective targets under on-policy AR cache dynamics, without changing the sampler, number of denoising steps, or inference-time cache mechanism. We apply OPSD-V to representative few-step AR video models, including Self-Forcing and LongLive. Experiments show consistent improvements in visual quality, motion dynamics, and VBenchLong scores. A user study with 10 participants comparing 20 video pairs shows that OPSD-V is preferred over the base models in 66.0% of overall-preference judgments (82.5% excluding ties).

AI.title_translation: OPSD-V：用于训练后少步自回归视频生成器的在线策略自蒸馏
AI.tldr: OPSD-V是一种用于改进少步自回归视频生成器的方法，通过引入真实长视频数据作为训练时的时序上下文，提供密集轨迹级别的监督，从而减少长视频生成中的误差累积和运动动力学减弱问题，同时保持原始的少步推理路径。实验表明，该方法在视觉质量、运动动力学和长视频基准测试中均有提升，并获得用户研究的偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有的少步自回归视频生成器在生成长视频时存在误差累积和运动动力学减弱的问题。
AI.method: OPSD-V引入真实长视频数据作为训练时的时序上下文，并利用其提供密集的轨迹级别监督。学生模型遵循与推理时相同的自回归展开方式，并以其自身先前生成的KV缓存为条件。教师模型在学生模型访问的相同去噪状态下进行评估，但使用更干净的、与AR一致的时序缓存，其中可以将旧的历史替换为真实视频上下文。这在不改变采样器、去噪步数或推理时缓存机制的情况下，提供了在线策略AR缓存动态下的密集去噪级别纠正目标。
AI.result: OPSD-V在视觉质量、运动动力学和VBenchLong分数方面得到一致改进。用户研究显示，在20个视频对的比较中，66.0%（不包括平局则为82.5%）的整体偏好判断中，OPSD-V优于基础模型。
AI.conclusion: OPSD-V是一种有效的在线策略自蒸馏方法，能够显著提升少步自回归视频生成器在长视频生成任务中的性能，解决误差累积和运动动力学减弱的问题，并且无需修改推理过程。
AI.translation: 我们提出OPSD-V，一种用于训练后少步自回归（AR）视频扩散模型的在线策略自蒸馏范式。现有的少步AR视频生成器可以低延迟地生成长视频，但在长AR展开过程中仍然存在误差累积和运动动力学减弱的问题。OPSD-V在保持原始的少步推理路径的同时，减少了长序列退化。关键思想是在训练期间引入真实的长视频数据作为时序上下文，并利用它提供密集的轨迹级别监督。具体来说，学生模型遵循与推理时相同的展开方式，生成每个块都以其自身先前生成的KV缓存为条件。同时，教师模型在相同的学生访问的去噪状态下进行评估，但使用更干净的、与AR一致的时序缓存，其中旧的历史可以被真实视频上下文替换。这在不改变采样器、去噪步数或推理时缓存机制的情况下，提供了在线策略AR缓存动态下的密集去噪级别纠正目标。我们将OPSD-V应用于代表性的少步AR视频模型，包括Self-Forcing和LongLive。实验表明，在视觉质量、运动动力学和VBenchLong分数方面得到了一致的改进。一项有10名参与者的用户研究比较了20个视频对，结果显示在整体偏好判断中，OPSD-V比基础模型更受欢迎，占66.0%（不包括平局则为82.5%）。
AI.summary: OPSD-V是一种新颖的在线策略自蒸馏方法，旨在解决少步自回归视频生成器在生成长视频时遇到的误差累积和运动动力学退化问题。该方法通过在训练阶段引入真实长视频数据作为时序上下文，并利用其提供密集的目标监督，同时保持了原始的少步推理过程。实验和用户研究均证实了OPSD-V在提升视频质量、运动表现和整体感知效果方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 自蒸馏, 视频生成, 自回归模型, 少步推理, 时序上下文
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为OPSD-V的创新自蒸馏方法，有效解决了现有少步自回归视频生成器在长视频生成中的关键挑战。通过引入真实长视频数据作为监督信号，并设计精巧的教师-学生模型蒸馏机制，该方法在不牺牲推理效率的前提下，显著提升了视频的视觉质量和运动动态。尤其值得称赞的是，该方法能够直接应用于现有的先进模型，展示了其广泛的适用性和技术价值。未来的工作可以进一步探索其在不同类型视频生成任务中的潜力，以及更复杂的时序依赖建模。

title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
comments: Project Page: https://uniclawbench.github.io | GitHub Repo: https://github.com/HKU-MMLab/UniClawBench
summary: The rapid development of large language models and multimodal large language models has accelerated the emergence of proactive agents capable of operating everyday tools and assisting users in real-world environments. However, existing benchmarks struggle to evaluate such agents effectively, as they often rely on sandboxed environments and single-turn evaluation paradigms. Moreover, their scenario-based task taxonomies mix multiple model capabilities within the same task category, making it difficult to identify the root causes of agent failures. To address these limitations, we introduce UniClawBench, the first capability-driven benchmark designed to evaluate proactive agents in dynamic, real-world settings. UniClawBench is built around five foundational model capabilities: Skill Usage, Exploration, Long-Context Reasoning, Multimodal Understanding, and Cross-Platform Coordination. Based on these capabilities, we design 400 bilingual real-world tasks. Unlike previous benchmarks that rely on static, pre-recorded answers, our benchmark evaluates agents in live Docker containers using fine-grained, step-by-step completion checkpoints. Furthermore, we design a closed-loop evaluation strategy comprising an executor agent, a hidden supervisor agent, and a user agent to simulate realistic multi-turn human feedback without leaking grading criteria. To disentangle base model capabilities from framework-level design choices, we evaluate state-of-the-art models under multiple agent frameworks. Through comprehensive comparisons across both models and frameworks, we show how base model capabilities and agent framework designs jointly shape performance in real-world environments. To facilitate future research, we make our benchmark and code publicly available at https://github.com/HKU-MMLab/UniClawBench.

title: Geometry and Gradient-based Partitioning for Panoramic Outdoor Reconstruction
summary: Scaling 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to large outdoor scenes is costly in both data acquisition and computation. Adopting panoramic images with equirectangular projection (ERP) can reduce capture effort via their full $360^{\circ}$ field of view, yet the resulting omnipresent visibility invalidates existing partitioning strategies that rely on local camera frustums, causing block-wise optimization to degenerate into global training. Thus, we propose PanoLOG, a two-stage coarse-to-fine framework equipped with a Geometry and Gradient-based Partitioning Strategy tailored for large-scale panoramic 3DGS reconstruction. In the global coarse stage, PanoLOG leverages sky-sphere modeling and panoramic monocular depth supervision for reliable geometry, while in the refinement stage, G$^2$PS builds adaptive bounding volumes via parallax-driven uncertainty and assigns cameras via gradient-based importance scoring. Furthermore, we construct Pano360, the first benchmark on large-scale panoramic dataset for outdoor scene reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that G$^2$PS achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality while maintaining scalable, block-parallel training. Our models, training code, and dataset are publicly available.

title: LongE2V: Long-Horizon Event-based Video Reconstruction, Prediction, and Frame Interpolation with Video Diffusion Models
summary: Recovering high-quality video from sparse event streams is a challenging task. Regression methods often blur textures, while existing generative models struggle with long-term stability. We propose LongE2V, a novel approach that leverages pre-trained video diffusion priors to jointly handle event-based video reconstruction, prediction, and frame interpolation. By fine-tuning a foundational video model, our approach achieves high data efficiency and superior perceptual quality. We introduce Autoregressive Unrolling and Adaptive Context Switching to mitigate temporal drift in extremely long sequences. We also propose Reencoding Alignment with Cross Residual Correction to ensure precise bidirectional consistency during frame interpolation. Furthermore, Event Voxel Density Augmentation ensures robustness across varying sensor resolutions. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that LongE2V outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all three tasks, exhibiting exceptional temporal coherence and zero-shot generalization. Project page: https://cdfan0627.github.io/LongE2V-page/

title: ZipDepth: Bringing Lightweight Zero-Shot Monocular Depth Anywhere, on Any Device
comments: ECCV 2026. Code: https://github.com/fabiotosi92/ZipDepth - Project page: https://zipdepth.github.io/
summary: Monocular depth estimation has seen remarkable progress through foundation models achieving robust zero-shot generalization, yet their computational demands place them far beyond the reach of embedded and mobile platforms. Lightweight alternatives exist, but have been developed almost exclusively within single-domain, self-supervised paradigms, failing silently under domain shift. We present ZipDepth, a compact monocular depth network that bridges this gap by combining an efficient reparameterizable encoder-decoder with large-scale knowledge distillation from a foundation model over a large multi-domain training set. Comprising just 6.1M parameters, ZipDepth runs at real-time rates from server GPUs to power-constrained devices, achieving the best trade-off between zero-shot accuracy and deployment efficiency among lightweight models across five benchmarks, taking a significant step towards the accuracy of foundation models with 50x more parameters.

title: Wat3R: Underwater 3D Geometry Learning without Annotations
comments: Accepted to ECCV 2026. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/LSXI7/Wat3R
summary: Estimating 3D geometry in underwater environments presents unique challenges due to light attenuation, scattering, and the absence of large-scale, high-quality 3D annotations. Pioneering methods rely on massive dense annotations that are impractical in underwater settings. In this paper, we propose Wat3R, a cross-domain semi-supervised learning framework designed to adapt feed-forward 3D reconstruction models from air to underwater scenes. Uniquely, our method eliminates the need for any annotated underwater data following a teacher-student architecture, that learns robust geometry representations merely on abundant unlabeled real underwater video footage. We also design a cross-view consistency loss that leverages geometric cues from other views to compensate for the information degradation in the current view caused by water attenuation and scattering. Furthermore, considering the lack of comprehensive evaluation benchmarks, we construct Water3D, a diverse dataset covering various water bodies and underwater scenarios, designed for geometric task evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that Wat3R outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in underwater multi-view depth estimation and point cloud reconstruction. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/LSXI7/Wat3R .

title: Statistical inverse learning problems with random observations
summary: We provide an overview of recent progress in statistical inverse problems with random experimental design, covering both linear and nonlinear inverse problems. Different regularization schemes have been studied to produce robust and stable solutions. We discuss recent results in spectral regularization methods and regularization by projection, exploring both approaches within the context of Hilbert scales and presenting new insights particularly in regularization by projection. Additionally, we overview recent advancements in regularization using convex penalties. Convergence rates are analyzed in terms of the sample size in a probabilistic sense, yielding minimax rates in both expectation and probability. To achieve these results, the structure of reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces is leveraged to establish minimax rates in the statistical learning setting. We detail the assumptions underpinning these key elements of our proofs. Finally, we demonstrate the application of these concepts to nonlinear inverse problems in pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) models, where the task is to predict changes in drug concentrations in patients.

title: Mixing of Glauber Dynamics on High Overlap Gibbs Measures
summary: We show fast mixing of Glauber dynamics for certain quadratic Gibbs measures with large external fields. The main ingredient is an overlap condition that allows us to control correlation matrices uniformly over all pinnings, by controlling norms of small submatrices of the interaction matrix. Using stochastic localization, we then obtain a lower bound on the spectral gap and, consequently, polynomial-time mixing of Glauber dynamics. As a direct application, we consider the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model, whose interaction matrix is a scaled GOE matrix. For this model, we show that for any fixed finite inverse temperature $β$, there exists a strength of external field $θ$, not depending on the size of the system, for which Glauber dynamics mixes in polynomial time (with high probability on the draw of the interaction matrix).

title: The Regularization Parameter: Sparse Precision Matrix Estimation
summary: Sparse precision matrix estimation provides an interpretable and computationally efficient framework for modeling conditional dependencies in high-dimensional, low-sample-size data. A recurring challenge is appropriately selecting the regularization parameter that controls estimator sparsity and strikes a balance between underfitting and overfitting. We propose a closed-form, matrix-valued regularization parameter derived from the sampling distribution of the first-order optimality conditions of the $\ell_1$-regularized Gaussian maximum-likelihood estimator. By prescribing the probability that each nonzero entry of the estimator satisfies its optimality condition under resampling, we eliminate the need for cross-validation. The resulting regularization parameter is shown to attain asymptotic scaling properties that, under standard conditions, provide consistency and sparsistency of the estimator. On synthetic Gaussian and non-Gaussian datasets, as well as real-world gene microarray and neuroimaging applications, the proposed approach achieves estimation accuracy comparable to cross-validation, delivers superior support recovery, and reduces runtime by several orders of magnitude.

title: Distributionally Faithful Imputation via Positive Semi-Definite Kernel Density Estimation
summary: Missing values undermine statistical inference and machine learning pipelines, yet most imputation methods rely on heuristics or restrictive parametric assumptions that ignore the joint data distribution. We recast imputation under missing completely at random (MCAR) as density estimation from masked observations: estimate a distribution whose observed marginals exactly match those in the data. Leveraging positive semi definite (PSD) kernel densities we obtain a convex empirical risk problem with closed form marginals, solvable by a Newton interior point method. The resulting PSD Impute model yields both single and multiple imputations from the same fitted density, enjoys statistical consistency with fast adaptive excess risk beating the curse of dimensionality for very regular probabilities. Preliminary experiments on one synthetic and eleven real world datasets already indicate competitive distributional accuracy compared with popular imputation baselines, suggesting strong practical promise.

AI.title_translation: 通过正半定核密度估计实现分布忠实的插补
AI.tldr: 该研究将MCAR下的缺失值插补重构为基于PSD核密度的密度估计问题，通过凸优化求解，并实现了具有竞争性分布准确性的单一和多重插补。
AI.motivation: 缺失值会损害统计推断和机器学习流程，而大多数现有插补方法依赖启发式或限制性参数假设，忽略了联合数据分布。
AI.method: 将MCAR下的插补重新定义为从掩蔽观测中进行密度估计，目标是估计一个其观测边际与数据中边际完全匹配的分布。利用正半定（PSD）核密度，获得一个具有封闭形式边际的凸经验风险问题，并通过牛顿内点法求解。
AI.result: PSD Impute模型能够从同一拟合密度生成单一和多重插补，具有统计一致性，并能实现快速自适应超额风险，克服了高维诅咒。初步实验在1个合成数据集和11个真实世界数据集上显示出与流行插补基线相比具有竞争力的分布准确性。
AI.conclusion: PSD Impute模型通过分布忠实的密度估计，在处理缺失值方面表现出强大的实用前景，能够提供统计一致且准确的插补。
AI.translation: 缺失值会损害统计推断和机器学习流程，然而大多数插补方法依赖于启发式或限制性参数假设，忽略了联合数据分布。我们将完全随机缺失（MCAR）下的插补重新定义为从掩蔽观测中进行密度估计：估计一个其观测边际与数据中边际完全匹配的分布。利用正半定（PSD）核密度，我们获得了一个具有封闭形式边际的凸经验风险问题，可通过牛顿内点法求解。由此产生的PSD Impute模型能够从同一拟合密度生成单一和多重插补，具有统计一致性，并能实现快速自适应超额风险，对于非常规则的概率可以克服维度诅咒。对一个合成数据集和十一个真实世界数据集的初步实验已经表明，与流行的插补基线相比，该方法具有竞争力的分布准确性，预示着强大的实用前景。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为PSD Impute的新型缺失值插补方法，该方法在完全随机缺失（MCAR）假设下，将插补问题重新构建为基于正半定（PSD）核密度的密度估计。通过解决一个具有封闭形式边际的凸经验风险问题，该模型能够从单一拟合密度生成单一和多重插补，并展现出统计一致性和克服维度诅咒的潜力。初步实验结果表明，PSD Impute在分布准确性方面优于现有流行方法，具有显著的实际应用前景。
AI.keywords: 缺失值插补, 密度估计, 正半定核, 凸优化, MCAR
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将缺失值插补问题转化为一个凸优化问题，并利用PSD核密度来估计联合数据分布，从而实现了分布忠实的插补。这种方法避免了传统启发式或限制性参数假设的缺点，并提供了统计一致性。在实际应用中，其生成单一和多重插补的能力以及在实验中展现的竞争力，表明了其重要性和广阔的应用前景。

title: Cascading Effects of the COVID-19 Pandemic on Barangays in the Philippines
summary: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted socio-economic and healthcare systems in the Philippines, significantly affecting barangays. This study analyzes the cascading effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on key aspects of a barangay, namely mobility, accessibility of public services, economic and financial health, food security, educational engagement, and physical health. It focuses on data from 2,122 Filipino households collected during May to June 2021 as part of the World Bank COVID-19 Households Survey. A Bayesian network model was constructed to programmatically map the conditional dependencies among these variables, utilizing Python libraries. Survey responses were grouped into common variables based on shared characteristics and standardized through z-score normalization to serve as nodes in the Bayesian network. By extending the Bayesian network into an influence diagram, the results will help identify interventions to guide local government units (LGUs) and policymakers in crafting tailored recovery programs and strategies that address impacts on physical health, economic and financial health, food security, public service access, mobility, and educational engagement. These efforts ultimately aim to enhance barangay resilience and preparedness for future public health crises. The results indicate that interventions aimed at boosting food production, stabilizing market prices, and expanding income opportunities are the most effective in improving community outcomes. This highlights the vital role of targeted economic and food security measures in mitigating the socio-economic impacts of the pandemic and offers valuable insights for shaping future response and recovery efforts.

AI.title_translation: 菲律宾COVID-19大流行对描笼涯的连锁效应
AI.tldr: 本研究分析了COVID-19大流行对菲律宾描笼涯在流动性、公共服务、经济健康、粮食安全、教育和身体健康方面的连锁影响，使用贝叶斯网络模型识别出促进粮食生产、稳定市场价格和扩大收入机会的干预措施最为有效。
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行扰乱了菲律宾的社会经济和医疗系统，对描笼涯产生了显著影响。本研究旨在分析大流行对描笼涯关键方面（如流动性、公共服务可及性、经济和财务健康、粮食安全、教育参与和身体健康）的连锁效应，并识别出可指导地方政府单位和政策制定者制定恢复计划和战略的干预措施，以增强描笼涯的韧性和应对未来公共卫生危机的准备。
AI.method: 该研究利用2021年5月至6月期间收集的2,122个菲律宾家庭的数据（来自世界银行COVID-19家庭调查）。构建了一个贝叶斯网络模型，并利用Python库程序化地绘制了这些变量之间的条件依赖关系。调查回复根据共同特征分组为常见变量，并通过z-score标准化作为贝叶斯网络中的节点。通过将贝叶斯网络扩展为影响图来识别干预措施。
AI.result: 结果表明，旨在促进粮食生产、稳定市场价格和扩大收入机会的干预措施在改善社区成果方面最为有效。
AI.conclusion: 本研究强调了有针对性的经济和粮食安全措施在减轻大流行社会经济影响方面的关键作用，并为制定未来的应对和恢复工作提供了宝贵的见解，最终目标是增强描笼涯的韧性和应对未来公共卫生危机的准备。
AI.translation: COVID-19大流行扰乱了菲律宾的社会经济和医疗系统，对描笼涯产生了显著影响。本研究分析了COVID-19大流行对描笼涯关键方面，即流动性、公共服务可及性、经济和财务健康、粮食安全、教育参与和身体健康，的连锁效应。研究重点关注2021年5月至6月期间收集的2,122个菲律宾家庭的数据，这些数据是世界银行COVID-19家庭调查的一部分。构建了一个贝叶斯网络模型，利用Python库程序化地绘制了这些变量之间的条件依赖关系。调查回复根据共同特征分组为常见变量，并通过z-score标准化作为贝叶斯网络中的节点。通过将贝叶斯网络扩展为影响图，结果将有助于识别干预措施，以指导地方政府单位（LGUs）和政策制定者制定量身定制的恢复计划和战略，解决对身体健康、经济和财务健康、粮食安全、公共服务可及性、流动性和教育参与的影响。这些努力最终旨在增强描笼涯的韧性以及应对未来公共卫生危机的准备。结果表明，旨在促进粮食生产、稳定市场价格和扩大收入机会的干预措施在改善社区成果方面最为有效。这突显了有针对性的经济和粮食安全措施在减轻大流行社会经济影响方面的关键作用，并为制定未来的应对和恢复工作提供了宝贵的见解。
AI.summary: 本研究分析了COVID-19大流行对菲律宾描笼涯社会经济和医疗系统的连锁效应，重点关注流动性、公共服务、经济健康、粮食安全、教育和身体健康。研究利用2,122个家庭的调查数据，构建了贝叶斯网络模型来映射变量间的依赖关系。结果表明，促进粮食生产、稳定市场价格和扩大收入机会的干预措施最能有效改善社区成果，为地方政府制定恢复策略和增强社区韧性提供了重要指导。
AI.keywords: COVID-19大流行, 描笼涯, 贝叶斯网络, 粮食安全, 经济影响
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过贝叶斯网络模型量化分析了COVID-19大流行对菲律宾描笼涯多方面的影响，其创新之处在于利用数据驱动的方法识别出关键的干预措施。研究结果对政策制定者具有直接的指导意义，尤其是在应对未来公共卫生危机时，强调了经济和粮食安全措施的重要性。

title: A Sparse and Truncated State Vector Simulator for Peaked Circuits
summary: In a class of quantum circuits known as peaked circuits, the goal is to predict the most probable bit string at the output of the circuit. Since these circuits are designed to have a sharp peak in their output distribution, in principle it should be possible to simulate them using a truncated state vector with a limited number of terms, or a fraction of the total probability mass. This approximate simulation can be carried out on a classical computer with a sparse representation that stores only the nonzero amplitudes of the state vector, in contrast to the dense representations that are common in most quantum simulators. For efficiency, all operations on the state vector should be vectorized to the furthest possible extent and, if available, hardware acceleration can also be used. This work describes how these requirements were met in an open-source implementation, and discusses its performance and limitations.

AI.title_translation: 用于尖峰电路的稀疏截断态向量模拟器

AI.conclusion: 该论文介绍了一种利用稀疏截断态向量方法对尖峰量子电路进行模拟的开源实现，并详细讨论了其性能和局限性。

title: Towards Robust Semantic Video Transmission over Block Erasure Channels
comments: accepted and will be presented at IEEE VTC FALL 2026
summary: This paper investigates semantic-aware neural joint source-channel coding (JSCC) for robust video transmission over block erasure channels. We propose a neural video compression framework exploring both spatial-domain and feature-domain designs. In the spatial domain, video frames are partitioned into blocks, enabling localized erasure handling and fine-grained robustness control via uniform erasure and two-level, semantic-guided non-uniform erasure strategies. In the feature domain, latent features are partitioned, enabling missing features to be semantically recovered while maintaining overall spatial consistency. Comprehensive experiments quantify reconstruction quality under varying uniform and non-uniform erasure probabilities. Our results show that spatial-domain JSCC excels at handling random localized losses, whereas feature-domain JSCC provides superior robustness to distributed erasures and maintains fidelity under low-loss scenarios. The analysis highlights the trade-offs between spatial continuity and semantic redundancy, offering insights for designing robust, task-aware video communication systems.

AI.title_translation: 面向块擦除信道的鲁棒语义视频传输
AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种用于在块擦除信道上进行鲁棒视频传输的语义感知神经联合源信道编码（JSCC）框架，该框架结合了空间域和特征域设计，以处理局部损失和分布式擦除。
AI.motivation: 在块擦除信道上实现鲁棒的语义视频传输。

AI.result: 空间域JSCC擅长处理随机局部损失，而特征域JSCC对分布式擦除具有卓越的鲁棒性，并在低损耗场景下保持高保真度。
AI.conclusion: 空间连续性和语义冗余之间存在权衡，这为设计鲁棒、任务感知的视频通信系统提供了见解。

title: Tree-based solution representations for quadratic bilinear systems and their consequences in model order reduction
summary: We investigate quadratic bilinear systems by developing novel tree-based representations of their solutions. The proposed framework decomposes the solution into a sequence of coupled bilinear subsystems whose components admit explicit expansions indexed by full binary trees. These representations yield sufficient conditions for the existence of global solutions and lead to new output bounds in terms of reachability Gramians. Motivated by these estimates, we introduce time-limited and infinite-horizon reachability and observability Gramians, establish sufficient conditions for their existence, and characterize them through nonlinear matrix equations. The associated Gramians are employed to identify dominant state-spaces and to derive exact reduced-order models obtained by removing Gramian kernels. Building on these results, we develop a balanced truncation method for quadratic bilinear systems and prove an error bound for the reduced-order approximation. The proposed framework provides a unified connection between tree-based solution representations, nonlinear Gramian theory, and balanced truncation for quadratic bilinear systems, closing several theoretical gaps in the analysis of Gramian-based model reduction for this class of systems.

AI.title_translation: 二次双线性系统的基于树的解表示及其在模型降阶中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文研究了二次双线性系统，开发了基于树的解表示，引入了新的可达性/可观测性Gramian，并基于此提出了一种平衡截断模型降阶方法，弥补了理论空白。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机是利用新的输出界限估计，引入时间受限和无限视界可达性及可观测性Gramian，并解决二次双线性系统Gramian模型降阶分析中的几个理论空白。
AI.method: 本文通过开发其解的新型基于树的表示来研究二次双线性系统。该框架将解分解为一系列耦合的双线性子系统，其分量通过完整二叉树进行显式展开。在此基础上，引入了时间受限和无限视界可达性与可观测性Gramian，并通过非线性矩阵方程对其进行表征。这些Gramian用于识别主导状态空间并推导出精确的降阶模型。最后，开发了一种二次双线性系统的平衡截断方法。
AI.result: 研究结果包括：基于树的解表示为全局解的存在性提供了充分条件，并产生了基于可达性Gramian的新输出界限。建立了时间受限和无限视界可达性与可观测性Gramian的存在性充分条件，并通过非线性矩阵方程对其进行了表征。利用相关Gramian识别了主导状态空间并导出了精确的降阶模型。为二次双线性系统开发了平衡截断方法，并证明了降阶近似的误差界限。
AI.conclusion: 该论文的结论是，所提出的框架在二次双线性系统的基于树的解表示、非线性Gramian理论和平衡截断之间提供了统一的连接，弥补了此类系统基于Gramian的模型降阶分析中的几个理论空白。

title: Kime-Representation Formulations of Three Open Problems in the Foundations of Classical Mechanics: Uncertainty, Invariant Entropy, and Directional Degrees of Freedom
summary: We give mathematically self-contained formulations, in the complex-time (kime) representation, of three open problems from the foundations of classical mechanics: (I) the extension of the classical entropic uncertainty principle to non-canonical variables and to multiple degrees of freedom; (II) the characterization of coordinate-invariant measures and entropies, i.e., the question of why continuous physical quantities must be paired for an invariant entropy to exist; and (III) the construction of a classical relativistic directional degree of freedom (a classical analogue of a spin-1/2 system). Throughout, the kime phase is interpreted {statistically as a latent circular random variable whose law Φmodels the intrinsic trial-to-trial variability of repeated, identically controlled experiments indexed by the kime magnitude. The mathematical bridge is an exact symplectic identification of the kime cone with the action-angle chart of a one-degree-of-freedom phase space, under which the kime measure is the Liouville measure and the phase law becomes the angular conditional of a Liouville density. Specifically, we (i) prove a sharp entropic uncertainty relation on the kime cylinder whose extremal family is von Mises x Gaussian, together with a sharp circular Fisher-information inequality saturated exactly by von Mises laws; (ii) prove an exact non-canonical uncertainty relation in which the correction term is the geometric mean of the Poisson bracket, clarifying the conjectured role of the expected bracket; (iii) prove aggregate multi-degree-of-freedom bounds via the Williamson normal form and Fischer's inequality, and isolate the per-degree-of-freedom refinement as a precise open problem of symplectic Schur-Horn type; (iv) prove that diffusion of the kime phase produces monotone entropy growth with the equipartitioned (Haar-uniform) phase law.

AI.title_translation: 经典力学基础中的三个开放问题的Kime表示公式：不确定性、不变熵和方向自由度
AI.tldr: 本文在复时间（kime）表示中，对经典力学基础中的三个开放问题进行了数学上自洽的阐述和解决，这些问题涉及不确定性、不变熵和经典相对论方向自由度（经典的自旋-1/2系统模拟）。
AI.motivation: 本文的动机是在经典力学基础中，利用复时间（kime）表示法，对三个开放问题进行数学上自洽的阐述和解决。这些问题包括：(I) 将经典熵不确定性原理扩展到非正则变量和多自由度；(II) 表征坐标不变的度量和熵，即解释为什么连续物理量必须成对才能存在不变熵；以及 (III) 构建一个经典相对论方向自由度（经典自旋-1/2系统的模拟）。
AI.method: 本文采用的核心方法是复时间（kime）表示。在这一表示中，kime相位被统计地解释为一个潜在的循环随机变量。数学上的桥梁是将kime锥与单自由度相空间的动量-角度图精确地辛识别，在此之下，kime测度是刘维尔测度，相位定律成为刘维尔密度的角度条件。具体方法包括：证明kime圆柱上的尖锐熵不确定关系和尖锐圆形费雪信息不等式；证明一个精确的非正则不确定关系；通过威廉姆逊范式和费雪不等式证明聚合多自由度界限；证明kime相位的扩散产生单调熵增长。
AI.result: 本文取得了以下结果：(i) 证明了kime圆柱上的一个尖锐熵不确定关系（极值族：von Mises x Gaussian）和一个恰好由von Mises定律饱和的尖锐圆形费雪信息不等式；(ii) 证明了一个精确的非正则不确定关系，其中修正项是泊松括号的几何平均值；(iii) 通过威廉姆逊范式和费雪不等式证明了聚合多自由度界限，并将每个自由度的细化分离为一个精确的辛舒尔-霍恩型开放问题；(iv) 证明了kime相位的扩散会产生伴随均分（Haar均匀）相位定律的单调熵增长。
AI.conclusion: 本文利用复时间（kime）表示法，对经典力学基础中的三个开放问题，即不确定性、不变熵和方向自由度，进行了数学上自洽的阐述和研究，并取得了重要的理论成果，为理解这些基础问题提供了新的视角和解决方案。
AI.translation: 我们以复时间（kime）表示法，对经典力学基础中的三个开放问题进行了数学上自洽的阐述：(I) 将经典熵不确定性原理扩展到非正则变量和多自由度；(II) 表征坐标不变的度量和熵，即为什么连续物理量必须成对才能存在不变熵的问题；以及 (III) 构建一个经典相对论方向自由度（经典自旋-1/2系统的模拟）。在整个过程中，kime相位被统计地解释为一个潜在的循环随机变量，其定律 Φ 模拟了由kime量级索引的重复、相同控制实验的内在逐次试验变异性。数学上的桥梁是将kime锥与单自由度相空间的动量-角度图精确地辛识别，在此之下，kime测度是刘维尔测度，相位定律成为刘维尔密度的角度条件。具体来说，我们 (i) 证明了kime圆柱上的一个尖锐熵不确定关系，其极值族是von Mises x Gaussian，同时证明了一个恰好由von Mises定律饱和的尖锐圆形费雪信息不等式；(ii) 证明了一个精确的非正则不确定关系，其中修正项是泊松括号的几何平均值，澄清了预期括号的推测作用；(iii) 通过威廉姆逊范式和费雪不等式证明了聚合多自由度界限，并将每个自由度的细化分离为一个精确的辛舒尔-霍恩型开放问题；(iv) 证明了kime相位的扩散会产生伴随均分（Haar均匀）相位定律的单调熵增长。
AI.summary: 本文利用复时间（kime）表示法，对经典力学基础中的三个核心开放问题进行了深入研究：不确定性原理的扩展、坐标不变熵的表征以及经典方向自由度的构建。通过将kime相位统计解释为潜在循环随机变量，并将其与动量-角度图进行辛识别，本文证明了一系列关键结果，包括kime圆柱上的尖锐熵不确定关系、非正则不确定关系以及多自由度界限，并揭示了kime相位扩散导致的熵增长。研究不仅提供了这些问题的数学自洽阐述，还提出了一系列具体的解决方案和新的开放问题。
AI.keywords: Kime表示, 经典力学, 不确定性原理, 不变熵, 方向自由度
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于引入了复时间（kime）表示法，并将其与辛几何相结合，为经典力学中的一些深层基础问题提供了新的数学框架和统计解释。通过将kime相位视为潜在的循环随机变量，该研究为理解不确定性原理、不变熵的存在条件以及经典自旋模拟等问题提供了独特的视角和具体的数学证明。同时，文中识别出“每个自由度的细化”是一个精确的辛舒尔-霍恩型开放问题，这表明该研究不仅解决了问题，也为未来的研究指明了方向。

title: False Confidence: Automated Labels Confound Fairness Audits in Cervical Spine Segmentation
comments: 8 pages, 1 figure. Under review at FAIMI 2026 (MICCAI workshop)
summary: Automated segmentation of cervical-spine MRI is increasingly used in clinical workflows, yet no fairness audit exists for this anatomy. We show that auditing these segmentation tasks is complicated by a common property of modern segmentation datasets: expert-annotated gold labels are expensive, so abundant machine-generated (silver) labels are added to limit annotation cost. This matters because the reference used to judge a model can itself be biased. In this study, we present the first fairness audit of cervical-spine MRI segmentation across sex, age, and race using the CSpineSeg dataset. We observe that the deployed model is demographically fair, but the choice of reference label, however, is not neutral. Because a dataset's silver labels are generated by a model trained on its gold labels, any new model trained on those same gold labels agrees more with the silver labels than with expert truth: scoring identical predictions against silver rather than gold overestimates performance by ~8 Dice points and turns the fairness verdict for age from non-significant to significant - not by the gap inflation Parikh et al. report (which we term false magnitude) but by collapsing within-group variance (which we term false confidence). Reference-label provenance is thus a first-order confounder in segmentation evaluation: performance and fairness should be reported against expert labels, and any fairness claim stated together with the provenance of its reference.

AI.title_translation: 错误置信：自动化标签混淆了颈椎分割中的公平性审计
AI.tldr: 自动化标签在分割数据集中可能会误导公平性审计，高估性能并扭曲公平性结论，尤其是在颈椎MRI分割中。
AI.motivation: 颈椎MRI的自动化分割越来越多地应用于临床工作流程，但目前尚无针对此解剖结构的公平性审计。现代分割数据集通常添加大量机器生成的（银色）标签以限制标注成本，而这些参考标签本身可能存在偏差，从而使分割任务的公平性审计复杂化。
AI.method: 本研究使用CSpineSeg数据集，首次对颈椎MRI分割在性别、年龄和种族方面的公平性进行了审计，并比较了模型在专家标注（金色）标签和机器生成（银色）标签下的性能和公平性。
AI.result: 部署的模型在人口统计学上表现出公平性，但参考标签的选择并非中立。基于金色标签训练的新模型与银色标签的一致性高于与专家真值的一致性。与银色标签而非金色标签进行评分，性能被高估约8个Dice点，并且年龄的公平性结论从不显著变为显著。这并非由于“虚假幅度”（间隙膨胀），而是由于“虚假置信”（组内方差崩溃）所致。
AI.conclusion: 参考标签的来源是分割评估中的一级混淆因素：性能和公平性应根据专家标签报告，并且任何公平性声明都应说明其参考标签的来源。
AI.translation: 自动化颈椎MRI分割在临床工作流程中越来越多地使用，但目前尚无针对此解剖结构的公平性审计。我们表明，审计这些分割任务的复杂性在于现代分割数据集的一个共同特性：专家标注的金色标签成本高昂，因此添加了大量机器生成的（银色）标签以限制标注成本。这很重要，因为用于判断模型的参考本身可能存在偏差。在本研究中，我们使用CSpineSeg数据集，首次对颈椎MRI分割在性别、年龄和种族方面的公平性进行了审计。我们观察到，部署的模型在人口统计学上是公平的，但参考标签的选择并非中立。由于数据集的银色标签是由在金色标签上训练的模型生成的，因此任何在相同金色标签上训练的新模型与银色标签的一致性高于与专家真值的一致性：与银色标签而非金色标签进行评分，性能被高估约8个Dice点，并且年龄的公平性结论从不显著变为显著——这并非由Parikh等人报告的间隙膨胀（我们称之为虚假幅度）引起，而是由组内方差崩溃（我们称之为虚假置信）引起。因此，参考标签的来源是分割评估中的一级混淆因素：性能和公平性应根据专家标签报告，并且任何公平性声明都应说明其参考标签的来源。
AI.summary: 本研究首次对颈椎MRI分割进行了公平性审计，并发现自动化（银色）标签可能导致对模型性能和公平性的错误评估。由于银色标签是由在专家（金色）标签上训练的模型生成的，因此使用银色标签进行评估会高估性能并改变公平性结论，表现为“虚假置信”。论文强调，在分割评估中，参考标签的来源是一个关键的混淆因素，并建议应始终根据专家标签报告性能和公平性，并明确说明参考标签的来源。
AI.keywords: 自动化标签,公平性审计,颈椎分割,参考标签来源,虚假置信
AI.comments: 这篇论文揭示了机器学习模型评估中一个重要的、以前可能被忽视的问题，尤其是在使用混合标注数据集进行公平性审计时。其创新之处在于明确区分了“虚假幅度”和“虚假置信”两种由于参考标签偏差导致评估失真的机制，并强调了后者（组内方差崩溃）在实际应用中的影响。研究的重要性在于提醒研究人员和实践者，即使是看似无害的自动化标签，也可能深刻影响对模型性能和公平性的判断，从而可能导致错误的临床决策或不公平的系统部署。论文提出了明确的建议，即应优先使用专家标签进行评估，并公开参考标签的来源，这对提高医疗AI的可靠性和公平性具有重要指导意义。

title: Multi-agent Autoformalization of Tensor Network Theory
comments: 5+2+33 pages; 3+3+11 figures; 6 tables; An accompanying blueprint document is available at https://lionsr.github.io/TNLean/blueprint-ch01-12.pdf
summary: We build a team of specialized large language-model agents and present an agent-driven workflow for research-level formalization in theoretical physics, with the autoformalization of the fundamental theorem of matrix-product states as a demonstration. The agents, coordinated through a structured mathematical blueprint and periodic human review, orchestrated and executed the full formalization autonomously. For some statements, the agents were able to explore new proof routes that are not part of the standard literature. Along the way the agents produced extensive tensor-network and quantum-information libraries not previously available in Mathlib, Lean's mathematical library. As a physical application, the formalization also extends towards symmetry-protected topological phases in one dimension. We find that the main bottleneck in large-scale autoformalization is enforcing mathematical intent and we provide a detailed study of the full process and various subtleties involved. We release the codebase as the library \href{https://github.com/LionSR/TNLean}{TNLean}, together with a \nChapters{}-chapter \href{https://lionsr.github.io/TNLean/blueprint/}{blueprint} of the formalization effort.

AI.title_translation: 张量网络理论的多智能体自动形式化
AI.tldr: 该研究利用LLM智能体团队实现了理论物理中张量网络理论的自动形式化，并生成了新的数学库和证明路径。
AI.motivation: 旨在利用LLM智能体实现理论物理研究级形式化，并克服大规模自动形式化中强制数学意图的瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建了一个由专业大型语言模型（LLM）智能体组成的团队，通过结构化的数学蓝图和定期人工审查进行协调，自主地编排和执行了矩阵乘积态基本定理的完整形式化。
AI.result: 智能体能够探索标准文献中未有的新证明路径；生成了Mathlib中以前没有的广泛的张量网络和量子信息库；形式化工作扩展到一维对称保护拓扑相；识别出大规模自动形式化的主要瓶颈是强制数学意图。
AI.conclusion: 成功展示了LLM智能体团队在理论物理研究级形式化方面的能力，产生了新的数学资源和证明方法，并识别了自动形式化中的关键挑战，即数学意图的强制执行。
AI.translation: 我们建立了一个由专业大型语言模型智能体组成的团队，并提出了一种由智能体驱动的工作流程，用于理论物理中的研究级形式化，以矩阵乘积态基本定理的自动形式化作为演示。这些智能体通过结构化的数学蓝图和定期的人工审查进行协调，自主地编排和执行了完整的形式化。对于某些陈述，智能体能够探索标准文献中没有的新证明路径。在此过程中，智能体生成了Mathlib（Lean的数学库）中以前没有的广泛的张量网络和量子信息库。作为一项物理应用，该形式化工作还扩展到一维对称保护拓扑相。我们发现大规模自动形式化的主要瓶颈是强制数学意图，我们对整个过程和所涉及的各种微妙之处进行了详细研究。我们将代码库作为库TNLean发布，并附有形式化工作的蓝图。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一个由大型语言模型智能体组成的团队，用于理论物理中张量网络理论的研究级自动形式化。该团队自主完成了矩阵乘积态基本定理的形式化，并在此过程中发现了新的证明方法，创建了Mathlib中缺失的张量网络和量子信息库。研究还探讨了形式化在一维对称保护拓扑相中的应用，并指出大规模自动形式化的主要挑战在于强制数学意图。相关代码库TNLean已发布。
AI.keywords: 多智能体, 自动形式化, 张量网络理论, 大型语言模型, Mathlib
AI.comments: 本文创新性地利用多智能体LLM团队实现了理论物理中复杂的张量网络理论的自动形式化，不仅展示了LLM在数学证明探索方面的潜力，还为形式化数学库Mathlib贡献了新的物理学相关内容。其对大规模自动形式化中“强制数学意图”瓶颈的识别和研究，为未来该领域的发展指明了方向，具有重要的实践和理论意义。

title: Size independence of consistency index for pairwise comparison matrices in analytic hierarchy process
summary:
Pairwise comparisons are fundamental in the analytic hierarchy process. Various consistency indices have been proposed to assess inconsistencies in these comparisons. Since Saaty first proposed his consistency index, the assessment of the degree of consistency in pairwise comparison matrices has remained an open and hot topic in the study of the analytic hierarchy process. The consistency indices CI and CR proposed by Saaty are defined using the principal eigenvalue of the pairwise comparison matrix. In our previous study, we introduced an alternative index derived from the relationship between the coefficient of the characteristic polynomial and the consistency of comparisons.
  Saaty proposed a fixed threshold of 0.1 for CI or CR as a guideline for an acceptable level of consistency, regardless of the matrix size. However, whether this threshold represents an equivalent level of consistency across different matrix sizes, that is, across different numbers of evaluation items, remains unclear. This study analysed the relationship between consistency and matrix size by examining pairwise comparison matrices constructed from subsets of evaluation items. Based on this analysis, we propose the fundamental property to be satisfied by a size-independent consistency index.
  Furthermore, we refine our previously proposed index to ensure that it satisfies this property, demonstrating that it coincides with the existing consistency index. Finally, we visualise the relationship between the matrix size and consistency index values using randomly generated pairwise comparison matrices, thereby providing insights into the impact of matrix size on consistency evaluation.

AI.title_translation: 解析层次过程中成对比较矩阵一致性指标的尺寸独立性
AI.tldr: 本研究分析了层次分析法中成对比较矩阵一致性指数的尺寸独立性，提出了一个尺寸独立性属性，并改进了之前提出的指数以满足该属性，同时通过可视化提供了矩阵尺寸对一致性评估影响的见解。
AI.motivation: Saaty提出的0.1一致性阈值在不同矩阵尺寸下是否代表相同的一致性水平尚不清楚，这是本研究的主要动机。
AI.method: 本研究通过检查由评估项目子集构建的成对比较矩阵，分析了一致性与矩阵尺寸之间的关系；提出了一个尺寸独立一致性指数应满足的基本属性；并改进了之前提出的指数以满足该属性，同时使用随机生成的成对比较矩阵可视化了矩阵尺寸与一致性指数值之间的关系。
AI.result: 本研究提出了一个尺寸独立一致性指数应满足的基本属性；改进后的指数被证明与现有的一致性指数一致；并通过可视化提供了矩阵尺寸对一致性评估影响的见解。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过分析矩阵尺寸对一致性评估的影响，提出了一个尺寸独立的一致性指数应满足的基本属性，并改进了现有指数以满足该属性，从而加深了对层次分析法中一致性评估的理解。
AI.translation:
成对比较是层次分析法的基本组成部分。人们提出了各种一致性指数来评估这些比较中的不一致性。自Saaty首次提出其一致性指数以来，成对比较矩阵中一致性程度的评估一直是层次分析法研究中的一个开放和热门话题。Saaty提出的一致性指数CI和CR是使用成对比较矩阵的主特征值定义的。在我们之前的研究中，我们引入了一个替代指数，该指数源于特征多项式系数与比较一致性之间的关系。
  Saaty提出了一个固定的0.1阈值作为CI或CR可接受的一致性水平的指导方针，而与矩阵尺寸无关。然而，这个阈值是否代表不同矩阵尺寸（即不同数量的评估项目）下等效的一致性水平，仍不清楚。本研究通过检查由评估项目子集构建的成对比较矩阵，分析了一致性与矩阵尺寸之间的关系。基于此分析，我们提出了一个尺寸独立的一致性指数应满足的基本属性。
  此外，我们改进了我们之前提出的指数，以确保其满足此属性，证明它与现有的一致性指数一致。最后，我们使用随机生成的成对比较矩阵可视化了矩阵尺寸与一致性指数值之间的关系，从而提供了对矩阵尺寸对一致性评估影响的见解。
AI.summary: 本文研究了层次分析法中成对比较矩阵一致性指数的尺寸独立性问题。针对Saaty提出的一致性阈值在不同矩阵尺寸下适用性不明的问题，文章分析了一致性与矩阵尺寸的关系，提出了一个尺寸独立一致性指数应满足的基本属性。在此基础上，作者改进了先前提出的指数以满足该属性，并证明其与现有指数一致。通过可视化随机生成的矩阵，论文为矩阵尺寸对一致性评估的影响提供了深入见解。
AI.keywords: 层次分析法, 成对比较矩阵, 一致性指数, 尺寸独立性, 评估
AI.comments: 本文解决了层次分析法中一个长期存在且重要的开放问题，即一致性指数阈值在不同矩阵尺寸下的有效性。通过提出尺寸独立性属性并改进现有指数，本研究为更准确和可靠的一致性评估提供了理论基础和实用方法，对于层次分析法的应用具有重要意义。

title: Expressivity and Statistical Trade-offs in Diffusion Policy Learning
summary: Diffusion-based policies have recently emerged as powerful policy parameterizations for reinforcement learning, representing state-conditioned action distributions as terminal laws of diffusion processes with parameterized drifts. This terminal-law representation has shown substantial expressive flexibility in practice, enabling diffusion policies to model complex, multimodal, and highly non-Gaussian action distributions; however, it remains unclear what mathematically drives this expressivity and how to fully exploit it when the policy is learned from finite data. In this paper, we identify the drift Lipschitz budget $K$ as a central quantity governing the expressivity and statistical behavior of diffusion policies. We quantify expressivity through approximation: diffusion policies with $K$-Lipschitz drifts can concentrate near optimal deterministic policies and achieve value approximation error of order $1/K$; moreover, we prove a matching lower bound under nondegenerate diffusion noise. This increased expressivity comes with a statistical cost. When the drift is parameterized by neural networks, increasing $K$ improves approximation but increases statistical complexity. Balancing these two terms yields a finite-sample performance gap of order $\tilde{O}(n^{-2/(m+6)})$ for generic neural-network drifts, and a sharper rate $\tilde{O}(n^{-2/(m+4)})$ for one-sided dissipative drift classes, where $n$ is the sample size and $m$ is the dimension of the state space. Numerical experiments provide empirical evidence for the sample-dependent trade-off in $K$, supporting both theoretical regimes. Our framework also suggests a practical implementation principle: choose the diffusion budget $K$ according to the available sample size, and then select a neural-network architecture with the corresponding fixed Lipschitz coefficient.

AI.title_translation: 扩散策略学习中的表达能力与统计权衡
AI.tldr: 本文研究了扩散策略的表达能力和统计特性，发现漂移Lipschitz预算K是关键，它在近似误差和统计复杂性之间存在权衡，并提供了有限样本性能界限和实践指导。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略在强化学习中展现出强大的表达能力，能够处理复杂、多模态和非高斯动作分布，但其数学驱动的表达能力以及在有限数据下如何充分利用它尚不明确。本研究旨在揭示扩散策略的表达能力与统计行为之间的权衡。
AI.method: 研究将漂移Lipschitz预算 $K$ 确定为控制扩散策略表达能力和统计行为的核心量。通过近似来量化表达能力，证明了 $K$-Lipschitz 漂移的扩散策略可以实现 $1/K$ 阶的值近似误差，并给出了匹配下界。分析了当漂移由神经网络参数化时，增加 $K$ 带来的统计成本，推导了有限样本性能差距。通过数值实验验证了理论结果，并提出了一个实用的实现原则。
AI.result: 漂移Lipschitz预算 $K$ 是控制扩散策略表达能力和统计行为的核心量。扩散策略的表达能力与值近似误差呈 $1/K$ 关系，且存在匹配下界。增加 $K$ 提高了近似能力但增加了统计复杂性。对于通用神经网络漂移，有限样本性能差距为 $	ilde{O}(n^{-2/(m+6)})$；对于单边耗散漂移类，性能差距为 $	ilde{O}(n^{-2/(m+4)})$。数值实验证实了 $K$ 中存在的样本依赖权衡。
AI.conclusion: 扩散策略的表达能力和统计成本之间存在根本的权衡，由漂移Lipschitz预算 $K$ 决定。在有限数据下，理解并平衡这种权衡至关重要。实际应用中，应根据可用的样本大小选择扩散预算 $K$，并选择具有相应固定Lipschitz系数的神经网络架构。
AI.translation:
扩散策略学习中的表达能力与统计权衡

基于扩散的策略最近已成为强化学习中强大的策略参数化方法，将状态条件动作分布表示为具有参数化漂移的扩散过程的终点律。这种终点律表示在实践中显示出显著的表达灵活性，使扩散策略能够建模复杂、多模态和高度非高斯的动作分布；然而，目前尚不清楚是什么在数学上驱动了这种表达能力，以及当策略从有限数据中学习时如何充分利用它。在本文中，我们将漂移Lipschitz预算 $K$ 确定为控制扩散策略表达能力和统计行为的核心量。我们通过近似来量化表达能力：具有 $K$-Lipschitz 漂移的扩散策略可以集中在最优确定性策略附近，并实现 $1/K$ 阶的值近似误差；此外，我们证明了在非退化扩散噪声下的匹配下界。这种增加的表达能力伴随着统计成本。当漂移由神经网络参数化时，增加 $K$ 改善了近似但增加了统计复杂性。平衡这两个项产生了通用神经网络漂移的 $	ilde{O}(n^{-2/(m+6)})$ 阶的有限样本性能差距，以及单边耗散漂移类的更尖锐的 $	ilde{O}(n^{-2/(m+4)})$ 阶的性能差距，其中 $n$ 是样本大小，$m$ 是状态空间的维度。数值实验为 $K$ 中依赖于样本的权衡提供了经验证据，支持了两种理论机制。我们的框架还提出了一个实用的实现原则：根据可用的样本大小选择扩散预算 $K$，然后选择具有相应固定Lipschitz系数的神经网络架构。
AI.summary: 本文深入探讨了扩散策略在强化学习中的表达能力与统计效率之间的权衡。研究发现，漂移Lipschitz预算 $K$ 是影响扩散策略近似能力和统计复杂性的关键因素。理论分析表明，提高 $K$ 可以改善策略对最优确定性策略的近似误差（达到 $1/K$ 阶），但同时会增加学习时的统计难度。文章量化了这种权衡，给出了在神经网络参数化漂移下有限样本性能的界限，并得到了数值实验的支持。最终，提出了根据样本量选择 $K$ 值以优化性能的实用指导原则。
AI.keywords: 扩散策略, 强化学习, 表达能力, 统计权衡, Lipschitz预算
AI.comments: 这篇论文对理解扩散策略的理论基础具有重要意义。它首次明确地量化了扩散策略的表达能力和统计成本之间的关系，并识别出漂移Lipschitz预算 $K$ 这一关键参数。提出的有限样本性能界限和实用的实现原则对于指导扩散策略的设计和应用具有很高的价值，尤其是在数据有限的实际场景中。

title: A Quantum Reservoir Architecture for Chaotic Forecasting and a Test of Whether Its High Dimension Helps
summary: Quantum reservoir computing uses a fixed quantum circuit as a feature generator and trains only a simple linear readout on top of it. This makes it cheap to train and free of the optimisation problems that affect many quantum machine-learning models. A natural worry is that the very large feature space the circuit produces might inflate apparent performance without adding anything real. This paper provides two things. First, it gives a complete, reproducible recipe for one such reservoir applied to forecasting chaotic systems, including how data is fed in, how the circuit is built, and how the readout is trained. Second, it gives a way to tell whether the reservoir's high dimension is actually doing useful work. We grow the size of the prediction problem and the size of the quantum reservoir together, so that extra capacity cannot be the explanation for any improvement, and we track a single stability number that measures how well behaved the readout fit is. On two chaotic test systems, a spatiotemporal chain and a shallow-water fluid model, the quantum reservoir keeps a flat, stable error as both sizes grow, while a matched classical reservoir does not. We report where the classical baseline is in fact stronger, so the comparison is honest. The result is a clean specification plus a diagnostic that other groups can apply to any reservoir whose features have a known scale.

AI.title_translation: 量子储备池架构用于混沌预测及其高维度是否有帮助的测试
AI.tldr: 本文探讨了量子储备池计算在混沌预测中的应用，并设计了一种方法来测试其高维度特征空间是否真正有效。研究发现，在问题规模和储备池规模同时增长时，量子储备池能保持稳定的预测误差，优于经典储备池，表明其高维度是有益的。
AI.motivation: 量子储备池计算训练成本低廉且避免了优化问题，但其巨大的特征空间可能仅是表面性能提升而无实际价值。本研究旨在解决这一担忧，并提供一个可复现的方法。
AI.method: 本文提供了一个完整的、可复现的量子储备池架构，用于混沌系统预测。通过同时增加预测问题和量子储备池的规模，并跟踪一个衡量读出器拟合稳定性的数字，来判断其高维度是否有效。研究在两个混沌测试系统上与匹配的经典储备池进行了比较。
AI.result: 在时空链和浅水流体模型这两个混沌测试系统上，量子储备池在问题和储备池规模同时增长时保持了平坦、稳定的误差，而匹配的经典储备池则未能做到。研究也诚实地报告了经典基线更强的场景。

AI.translation: 量子储备池计算使用一个固定的量子电路作为特征生成器，并且只在其之上训练一个简单的线性读出器。这使得其训练成本低廉，并且没有困扰许多量子机器学习模型的优化问题。一个自然的担忧是，电路产生的非常大的特征空间可能会夸大表观性能而没有增加任何实际价值。本文提供了两点。首先，它提供了一个完整、可重现的用于混沌系统预测的量子储备池的实现方法，包括数据如何输入、电路如何构建以及读出器如何训练。其次，它提供了一种判断储备池高维度是否确实在做有用工作的方法。我们同时增加预测问题的规模和量子储备池的规模，这样额外的容量就不能解释任何改进，并且我们跟踪一个衡量读出器拟合良好程度的单一稳定性数字。在两个混沌测试系统上，一个时空链和一个浅水流体模型，量子储备池在两种规模都增长时保持平坦、稳定的误差，而匹配的经典储备池则不然。我们报告了经典基线实际上更强的地方，因此比较是诚实的。结果是一个清晰的规范加上一个诊断工具，其他研究小组可以将其应用于任何特征具有已知尺度的储备池。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于混沌系统预测的量子储备池架构，解决了量子机器学习模型中训练成本高和优化问题。为了验证其高维度特征空间的实际效用，作者设计了一种方法，通过同时增加预测问题和储备池的规模，并跟踪稳定性指标。实验结果表明，在时空链和浅水流体模型这两个混沌系统上，量子储备池在规模增长时能保持稳定的预测误差，而经典储备池则不能。研究还诚实地指出了经典模型表现更优的场景。该研究提供了一个可复现的量子储备池实现方案和评估其高维特征空间有效性的诊断工具。
AI.keywords: 量子储备池计算, 混沌预测, 高维特征空间, 量子机器学习, 稳定性分析
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于提供了一个可复现的用于混沌预测的量子储备池计算方法，更重要的是，它提供了一种严格测试其高维特征空间效用的方法。通过同时扩展问题规模和储备池规模来隔离维度效应的做法非常巧妙。与经典基线的诚实比较也增加了其科学严谨性。

title: An Upper Bound on the Hat Guessing Number of Graphs
summary: The hat guessing number $HG(G)$ of a graph is defined by the following game: each player is placed on a vertex and assigned a hat with one of $k$ colors. Each vertex can see only the hat color of the other vertices it is connected to in $G$. All vertices guess, simultaneously, the color of their own hat. The hat guessing number $HG(G)$ is the largest $k$ such that the players can guarantee that at least one of them guesses correctly. In this paper, we show a general bound on the hat guessing number of a graph $G$ as a function of its order $n$ and its maximum degree $Δ$. This is the first nontrivial upper bound on $HG(G)$ as a function of $Δ$ and $n$ when $Δ\geq \frac{n}{e}$. From this result we also obtain that the hat guessing number of the random graph $G_{n,1/2}$ is at most asymptotically $cn$ for $c\sim 0.809$, and that graphs with maximum degrees of $ (1-\varepsilon )n$ for fixed $\varepsilon>0$ cannot have $HG(G)=(1-o(1))n$.

AI.title_translation: 图的帽子猜测数的上界
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个图的帽子猜测数的通用上界，该上界是图的阶数n和最大度Δ的函数。这是第一个关于Δ和n（当Δ≥n/e时）的非平凡上界。
AI.motivation: 确定图的帽子猜测数HG(G)的一个上界，特别是当最大度Δ较大时（Δ≥n/e），并将其应用于随机图和具有高最大度的图。
AI.method: 推导了一个关于图的阶数n和最大度Δ的帽子猜测数的通用上界。
AI.result: 提出了一个关于图的阶数n和最大度Δ的帽子猜测数的通用上界。推导结果表明，随机图G_{n,1/2}的帽子猜测数渐近上界为cn，其中c≈0.809。此外，最大度为(1-ε)n（固定ε>0）的图不能具有HG(G)=(1-o(1))n的帽子猜测数。

AI.keywords: 帽子猜测数, 图论, 上界, 最大度, 随机图
AI.comments: 该研究为图论中的帽子游戏问题提供了一个重要的理论贡献，特别是在分析具有特定结构（如高最大度或随机性）的图的帽子猜测数时。该上界对于理解和设计更优的帽子游戏策略具有潜在的应用价值。然而，该界限的紧密性以及是否能推广到更一般的图类仍是未来研究的方向。

title: SpO$_2$ Predictor-Guided Stage-Wise Time-Frequency Reconstruction of Low-Quality Dual-Wavelength PPG for Oxygen Saturation Estimation
summary: Continuous oxygen saturation (SpO$_2$) estimation from wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) is important for long-term health monitoring, but low-quality red and infrared PPG segments can distort waveform morphology and degrade SpO$_2$ prediction accuracy. Existing PPG denoising and reconstruction methods usually optimize waveform fidelity or heart rate characteristics, while time-domain waveform loss on PPG signals alone insufficiently preserves frequency structure and SpO$_2$-relevant information. This paper proposes a SpO$_2$ predictor-guided stage-wise time-frequency reconstruction framework for low-quality dual-wavelength PPG signals. The proposed method first selects high-quality PPG segments to pretrain a SpO$_2$ predictor. A masked reconstruction model is then trained to recover randomly masked PPG regions using a joint reconstruction objective that combines time-domain waveform loss with frequency-domain loss computed from the short-time Fourier transform (STFT). To make the reconstruction task physiologically relevant, the pretrained SpO$_2$ predictor is incorporated as an additional constraint, encouraging the reconstructed PPG to preserve SpO$_2$ information rather than only minimizing waveform reconstruction error. The SpO$_2$ predictor and PPG reconstructor model are optimized through four training stages. Experiments on the public OpenOximetry Repository and a private wearable PPG dataset show that the proposed approach achieves the lowest subject-level MAE, with 2.882\% on the public dataset and 2.359\% on the private dataset.

title: Reaction-network reasoning with frontier models for experimentally confirmed catalyst-selectivity hypotheses
summary: Catalysts are essential for sustainable chemical manufacturing, yet discovering novel architectures remains a bottleneck dominated by trial-and-error experimentation and computationally intensive screening. In complex reactions such as electrochemical carbon dioxide reduction, product selectivity is governed by dynamic interfacial, electrolyte, and potential factors as well as kinetic pathway competition. Conventional descriptor-based machine learning and computational potentials struggle to resolve these mechanistic branch points, primarily relying on static ground-state descriptors or bulk structural correlations rather than end-to-end topological pathway analysis. Here, we show that frontier language models, when strictly constrained to reason over explicit reaction networks, can discover novel catalysts by identifying the physical levers that govern pathway competition. We developed a human-AI co-thinking framework that enforces network invariance to extract testable hypotheses from complex chemical graphs. Applied to CO2 electroreduction, the framework identified ketene desorption and hydroxide capture as the acetate-forming pathway, and predicted a distinct adsorbed CO and CH2 coupling route to ketene. By isolating actionable control levers, specifically local alkalinity, controlled iron incorporation, and restricted interfacial proton-donor accessibility, the framework guided the prospective synthesis of a copper-iron oxide catalyst demonstrating a threefold increase in acetate selectivity over matched Cu-rich baselines. This mechanism-guided reasoning architecture shifts the computational paradigm from retrospective statistical prediction to forward-looking hypothesis generation, providing a broadly applicable blueprint for mechanism-guided materials discovery.

title: Unit-Independent Low-Rate Wrist GSR Processing for Stress Detection Using Phasic nSCR Features
summary: Galvanic skin response (GSR) is widely used for stress detection, but wrist-based GSR remains challenging because its absolute amplitude can differ substantially from laboratory-grade palmar measurements. In this paper, we propose a unit-independent low-rate wrist GSR processing pipeline to extract the number of skin conductance responses per minute (nSCR/min) as a stress-related feature. We collect paired wrist and palmar GSR recordings from 31 participants during sitting baseline, standing baseline, neutral speaking, and the Trier Social Stress Test (TSST), a laboratory social stressor task. The proposed pipeline cleans the raw GSR signal, decomposes it into tonic skin conductance level (SCL) and phasic skin conductance response (SCR), applies robust z-score normalization, and detects phasic SCR peaks to compute nSCR/min. Using random forest on 25Hz We-Be GSR, nSCR/min achieved balanced accuracies of 0.823 and 0.871 for binary classification between TSST and the sitting and standing baselines, respectively. Moreover, the 25Hz We-Be GSR features achieved comparable balanced accuracy to the original 100Hz features across the evaluated tasks. These results suggest the feasibility of low-rate, unit-independent wrist GSR processing for wearable stress detection.

title: From Bayes' Rule to Bayes Rules: Optimal Information Processing and Axiomatic Foundations Beyond Probability
summary: This paper develops principled updating rules for possibilistic inference, where uncertainty about a fixed parameter is represented by a possibility function, the maxitive analogue of a probability distribution, and comparisons are made pointwise via a partial order. From two complementary foundations, an information-conservation viewpoint and an axiomatic viewpoint, we derive the same canonical update: the posterior is the prior-likelihood product followed by supremum normalisation. The two derivations agree for an arbitrary loss, differing only in where the learning-rate parameter enters. This parameter controls epistemic strength and is not identifiable from the normalising evidence alone, clarifying the role of analogous learning-rate parameters in generalised Bayesian updating.

title: DKDNet: Dual Knowledge and Data-Driven Network for Cross-Domain Automatic Modulation Classification
summary: The dynamics of communication environments induce significant distribution shifts across domains, challenging the generalization of deep learning-based automatic modulation classification (AMC) models. While existing UDA methods alleviate this problem by aligning source and target features, they give limited consideration to modulation-specific structures that remain informative across domain conditions. In this paper, we consider signal prior knowledge, grounded in communication protocols and physical principles, as a potential way to enhance cross-domain representation learning. Given that different priors may vary in modulation discriminability, domain stability, and complementarity, this paper first analyzes five commonly adopted signal representations that instantiate different signal priors. From them, in-phase/quadrature (IQ), amplitude--phase (AP), and autocorrelation function (ACF) are selected as compact prior-guided inputs. Based on that, a dual knowledge and data-driven network (DKDNet) is proposed for cross-domain AMC. The multi-representation feature encoder (MRFE) and dynamic lightweight fusion unit (DLFU) are designed to achieve unified representation learning and adaptive feature fusion, and the resulting fused features are optimized with modulation classification and adversarial domain alignment objectives. Experiments on both simulated and public datasets validate the rationality of the prior selection and demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method.

title: ConRad: Efficient Conformal Prediction for Radiomics
summary: Radiomic features derived from medical images and segmentation masks are used to support decision making in clinical imaging pipelines. In practice, these features are often computed from predicted masks, but segmentation models can be overconfident or poorly calibrated, making derived measurements appear more reliable than they are. Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free prediction intervals with finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees, but black-box intervals for segmentation-derived radiomics can be inefficient because they ignore test-time information about image appearance, mask geometry, and segmentation uncertainty. We propose ConRad, a conformal framework for scalar radiomic targets that uses covariates derived from the predicted mask, input image, predicted radiomics, and boundary uncertainty to construct adaptive intervals while maintaining coverage. Across five 2D medical imaging datasets and 171 retained radiomic targets, we show that ConRad improves feature-level efficiency compared to baselines while maintaining near-nominal empirical coverage. Ablation results further indicate that segmentation boundary uncertainty features are the largest contributors to interval efficiency.

title: Equivariant Quantum Clustering with Differential Privacy: Parameter-Efficient Privacy-Preserving Analysis Across Heterogeneous Sensitive Datasets
comments: 24 pages, 10+ tables, multiple figures, research article. Introduces Equivariant Quantum Clustering (EQC) integrating differential privacy with parameter-efficient quantum circuits for privacy-preserving clustering. Evaluated on NSL-KDD, CERT Insider Threat v6.2, and Synthetic MIMIC-III datasets
summary: Privacy-preserving clustering is critical for analyzing sensitive data in healthcare, cybersecurity, and enterprise applications, where maintaining data confidentiality must be balanced with analytical performance. This paper presents Equivariant Quantum Clustering (EQC), a parameter-efficient framework that integrates symmetry-aware quantum circuits with differential privacy to improve the privacy-utility tradeoff. EQC employs p4m equivariant parameter sharing to reduce circuit complexity while preserving informative feature representations. The framework is evaluated on three privacy-sensitive datasets: NSL-KDD, CERT Insider Threat v6.2, and a synthetic MIMIC-III clinical dataset. On the NSL-KDD benchmark, EQC achieves 79.3% clustering accuracy while reducing membership inference attack success to 38.3% under a privacy budget of ε = 1.0 and δ = 10^-5, outperforming representative classical and quantum baselines. Ablation studies indicate that the performance gains primarily arise from parameter-efficient circuit design combined with differential privacy. The results demonstrate that EQC provides a practical quantum-ready framework for secure and privacy-preserving clustering across heterogeneous sensitive datasets.

title: Decomposition-Based QAOA for Maximum Coverage Location Problem in Satellite Constellation Design
comments: 21 pages, 12 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: An increase in earth observation missions has increased the demand of efficient design and optimization of satellite constellations. Maximizing coverage of the target while effectively utilizing the limited orbital resources is one of the critical design challenges for complex combinatorial optimization problems. The maximal covering location problem (MCLP), serves as a base for orbital coverage modeling, is NP-hard and computationally intractable for large-constellation instances. Using heuristics, metaheuristics, and mixed-integer linear programming, classical solvers have achieved optimal or near-optimal results, yet their scalability is limited as the problem size increases. Quantum computing advancements, including the quantum approximate optimization algorithms, offer a potential solution to NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems. Current quantum hardware limitations, such as low qubit counts and circuit depth, restrict solutions for small-scale instance problems. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a scalable quantum optimization framework for MCLP in satellite constellation design. A decomposition-based quantum methodology is proposed, in which large MCLP instances are partitioned into subgraphs by classical decomposition, optimized independently via quantum optimization circuits, and combined using quantum reconstruction strategies. Computational results across different constellation sizes reveal better scalability in less time while maintaining competitive coverage performance compared to classical solvers.
